finding: COMSOL 6.4 save(path,true) changed timeModified on a saved/restored model; an in-memory unsaved model did not show this effect.
decision: Require an explicit checkpoint bound by the service to the current full model_ref, post-save revision and fingerprint. Trial verifies the immutable artifact and creates its disposable copy from that file, never by saving the main model during trial.
invariants: Existing full main-model fingerprint and event-counter gate remains unchanged.
Reject stale or tampered snapshot before trial engine/file side effects.
Preserve source checkpoint; remove only trial-owned file/model.
Trial before/after revision and model identity remain equal; checkpoint creation is a separate explicit write.
Report save/copy cost separately; no large-model cost claim.
historical_checkpoints: Remain restorable under existing restore contract; new snapshot binding required for trial use.
rejected_alternative: Do not ignore timeModified changes or declare a changed full fingerprint unchanged.
